name: Said Reklaoui
headline: AI Engineer · LLMs, RAG & agents
tagline: I build AI systems that run in production.
summary: AI Engineer focused on applied AI in production. For the last three years I have built LLM-powered pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation, agent orchestration over MCP and fine-tuned open models on local inference, alongside AI woven through the software development lifecycle itself. What makes that work hold up is the fifteen years underneath it: shipping AI is a systems problem — evaluation, guardrails, cost, latency, observability and a team that can maintain it — and that is where architecture and engineering leadership earn their keep.

roles.title: AI Engineer · VP of Engineering
highlights: Lead a 20+ person engineering organisation across backend, frontend, infrastructure and AI.
Leading the adoption of AI agents across the whole software lifecycle, on an internal model-agnostic agent platform.
Raised engineering standards with mutation testing and quality gates in CI, and led an observability push that cut production error issues by ~75%.
Hands-on in event-driven systems on AWS (Kinesis, Lambda, SQS/SNS, ECS) for a multi-country platform, including high-throughput sync recovery.
Set architecture direction for a major API migration and for scaling an AI tutor in production.
Built the Activity Generator Service: an LLM-powered activity generation platform with versioned prompt catalogues, schema-validated output, multimodal document processing and per-batch cost control.

roles.title: AI Engineer
highlights: Designed and shipped email classification pipelines using ML and NLP, combining XGBoost with fine-tuned LLMs (Gemma 3B/7B).
Led a core event orchestrator automating key support flows — cancellations, modifications and hotel confirmations — integrating Dixa and Google Cloud.
Orchestrated intelligent agents over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to infer customer intent and trigger automated actions through external APIs.
Fine-tuned and converted Hugging Face models to optimised formats (GGUF) for local inference with Ollama.
Built internal annotation tooling so operations teams could label and curate training data.
Automated support workflows through multi-label classification and LLM-assisted response generation.

projects.name: Activity Generator Service
projects.description: Generates learning activities for an education platform, either authored by an LLM from a topic or source document or extracted and converted from activities printed in a PDF. Queue-based batch processing with progress and cancellation, a versioned prompt catalogue keyed by activity template and cognitive phase, schema-validated output, multimodal PDF chunking, per-batch cost estimation and tracing over every LLM call.
projects.tech: LLMs, Structured Outputs, Prompt Engineering, Evaluation, LangChain, LangGraph, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis

projects.name: CodeGuard — AI Code Review Platform (personal project)
projects.description: Code review platform that analyses structure, dependencies, impact and risk using specialised agents in parallel plus a verification pass. Served open models (Qwen3-Coder 30B → Qwen3.6-35B MoE, FP8) with vLLM on RunPod serverless GPUs behind an async job API; migrating from Ollama to vLLM took throughput from 78 to 226 tok/s aggregate at 5 concurrent sessions, ran a 128k context on a 96 GB GPU, and cut cold start by baking FP8 weights (image 164 GB → 40 GB). Golden-corpus bench for recall/precision and per-review cost billing, which later moved inference to a price-routed gateway.
projects.tech: vLLM, RunPod, GPU Inference, FP8, Qwen, AI Agents, Evaluation, Python

projects.name: RAG FAQ Agent on Vertex AI
